test_title: RRB Group D 2025 (New Pattern) Official Mock Test
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following number and symbol series and answer the question that follows. All numbers are single-digit numbers. Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) * 6 % Ω + 7 1 £ 2 4 5 9 # 3 @ 8 $ & (Right)

If all the symbols are dropped from the series, which of the following will be 6th from the right?
solution:
Given series:

(Left) * 6 % Ω + 7 1 £ 2 4 5 9 # 3 @ 8 $ & (Right)

Remove all the symbols from the given series.

New series after removing symbols:

6 7 1 2 4 5 9 3 8

Find the 6th element from the right end of the new series.

6 7 1 __**2**__ 4 5 9 3 8

The 6th element from the right end is **2**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
